summary: The type-tree collection helpers omit that their `owner` argument has no effect; otherwise the added documentation matches the traversal and rebuilding behavior.

items.issue: The `owner` tag omits that its value has no effect: the method only passes it to `transformTypeTree`, whose implementation ignores it. This conflicts with the project rule to identify unused parameters and can imply that ownership affects the result.
items.suggestion: State that `owner` is passed to `transformTypeTree` and is ignored, so its value has no effect.

items.issue: The `owner` tag omits that its value has no effect: it is passed through `transformTypeCaseDef` to `transformTypeTree`, which ignores it.
items.suggestion: State that `owner` is ultimately ignored and does not affect the returned cases.

items.issue: The summary is a noun phrase rather than the requested declarative, third-person API-index sentence.
items.suggestion: Use a declarative summary such as "Maps quoted expressions to expressions of the same type."
